caption: The drawing depicts a round, canteen-like object with a narrow neck and a cork or wooden stopper at the top. The canteen's main body is decorated with an illustration of a rooster standing on the ground, facing left, with detailed lines marking the feathers, tail, and wings. Surrounding the rooster are three large flower-like plants with elongated leaves and stems, also decorated with fine line details. Swirling vine patterns fill the background around the rooster and plants. The canteen has a yellow-brown, brass or bronze-like coloration with shading to indicate metallic texture and form. Small circular accents are visible along the outer rim of the canteen and around the base of the neck. The drawing uses mostly shades of yellow, brown, and gold. The lower right corner of the image contains the artist's name, "Marie Famularo," and dates "8-28-1937" and "9-16-1937" are written below. The drawing is composed on a plain, light beige background, and the overall style of illustration is precise and rendered with attention to decorative detail.
title: Warming Pan
